listing.summary: Adds a new faction with ships, weapons, and two new star systems, emphasizing energy weapons and point defense.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with ships, weapons, and two new star systems, emphasizing energy weapons and point defense.

description:
A faction pack containing a faction with ships, weapons and strikecraft.

Two star systems are added in the south of the sector, "Europa" and "Carthage".

The Europa Federation prefer energy weapons and have a emphasis on point defence.

If you do not like the idea of faction I have added a seperate Ship and Weapons download aswell.

This is very much work in progress and something I do in my spare time.

This is my first mod and I am looking for any helpful feedback or suggestions.

I would be grateful if someone could assist me in creating some missions and stations!

Requires:

Magic, Shader and LunaLib

aiDescription: Adds a new faction called the Europa Federation with unique ships, weapons, and strikecraft. Introduces two new star systems, Europa and Carthage, in the southern part of the sector. The faction specializes in energy weapons and point defense systems. Includes multiple ship classes such as the Carpathia, Tallinn, and Athens, along with new weapons like the Ehammer Torpedo and Talos missile.
